svg.text: Below these sizes the M's tube structure becomes illegible — fall back to the favicon set instead.

g.text: SCREEN · 64 px ≈ MIN FOR PHOTO M
Anything smaller, use the rounded token favicon.
PRINT · 12 mm ≈ MIN FOR PHOTO M
12 mm at 300 dpi = 142 px square. Below this, use the mono silhouette.
